sentences.en: One by one over the past few weeks, three boats in the Caribbean Sea have been blown up by the U.S.
sentences.zh: 在过去几周里，加勒比海的三艘船只被美国军方逐一炸毁，

sentences.en: military, killing all 17 people aboard.
sentences.zh: 船上17人全部丧生。

sentences.en: Each time, President Trump has claimed that the boats were carrying drugs to the U.S.
sentences.zh: 特朗普总统每次都声称这些船只在向美国运送毒品，

sentences.en: and that those killed were narco-terrorists.
sentences.zh: 并称死者是毒品恐怖分子。

sentences.en: But he's offered no concrete evidence to back up that claim.
sentences.zh: 但他没有提供任何确凿证据来支持这一说法。

sentences.en: Today, my colleague Charlie Savage on what he's learned about what may be the true objective behind these airstrikes and whether any of this is even legal.
sentences.zh: 今天，我的同事查理·萨维奇将分享他所了解到的情况，探讨这些空袭背后可能存在的真正目的，以及这一切是否合法。

sentences.en: It's Thursday, September 25th.
sentences.zh: 今天是9月25日，星期四。

sentences.en: Charlie, it's great to have you.
sentences.zh: 查理，很高兴你能来。

sentences.en: Thanks for having me on.
sentences.zh: 谢谢邀请。

sentences.en: We've come to you to talk about what's been happening off the coast of Venezuela over the past month.
sentences.zh: 我们找你是想谈谈过去一个月委内瑞拉海岸附近发生的事情。

sentences.en: We've now seen three separate U.S.
sentences.zh: 我们现在已经看到美国军方对三艘船只进行了三次独立的打击，

sentences.en: military strikes on boats that American officials say were carrying drugs.
sentences.zh: 美国官员称这些船只当时正在运送毒品。

sentences.en: And those strikes have come after Trump has been building up a military presence in the Caribbean Sea for weeks now.
sentences.zh: 而且这些打击发生之前，特朗普已经在加勒比海地区进行了数周的军事部署。

sentences.en: You cover national security.
sentences.zh: 你负责报道国家安全事务。

sentences.en: So help us understand what's going on here.
sentences.zh: 所以请帮我们了解一下这里到底发生了什么。

sentences.en: President Trump and the Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth have ordered military special operations forces in the Caribbean to attack boats in international waters, at least for now,
sentences.zh: 特朗普总统和国防部长皮特·海格塞斯已下令加勒比海的军事特种作战部队攻击国际水域的船只（至少目前如此），

sentences.en: that are suspected of smuggling drugs for certain cartels and gangs that Trump has controversially designated as terrorist organizations.
sentences.zh: 这些船只被怀疑为特朗普极具争议地指定为恐怖组织的某些贩毒集团和帮派走私毒品。

sentences.en: And this is a fundamental shift in how the United States has been dealing for years and years with the problem of drug smuggling coming out of Latin America across the water
sentences.zh: 这是美国多年来处理拉丁美洲跨海向美国走私毒品问题方式上的根本性转变。

sentences.en: towards the United States.
sentences.zh: 朝着美国方向。

sentences.en: In a really dramatic and legally disputed shift, the United States is claiming a right to summarily kill everyone on a boat it suspects of drug running in international waters
sentences.zh: 在一项非常戏剧性且在法律上存在争议的转变中，美国声称有权直接杀掉其怀疑在国际水域从事毒品运输的船上的所有人，

sentences.en: to essentially treat the issue of drug smuggling as if it's an armed attack on the United States and to kill people suspected of participating in that activity
sentences.zh: 本质上是将毒品走私问题视为对美国的武装攻击，并杀害被怀疑参与该活动的人，

sentences.en: as if they were combatants on a battlefield in a war.
sentences.zh: 就好像他们是战场上的战斗人员一样。

sentences.en: Safe to say these are extraordinary and unprecedented moves.
sentences.zh: 可以说这些举动是非同寻常且史无前例的。

sentences.en: Absolutely.
sentences.zh: 绝对是这样。

sentences.en: There's been pushing and tugging on the laws around armed conflict and the use of force in the 21st century because of the war on terrorism
sentences.zh: 由于反恐战争以及针对像基地组织这类非国家行为体的战争概念，21世纪关于武装冲突和武力使用的法律一直存在争议和拉锯。

sentences.en: and the notion of a war against a non-state actor like al-Qaeda.
sentences.zh: 以及针对像基地组织这样的非国家行为体的战争概念。

sentences.en: But this is fundamentally different than that.
sentences.zh: 但这与此有着本质的不同。

sentences.en: This is treating people who are civilians, even if they are suspected of being criminals, as if they were combatants and killing them without any kind of due process.
sentences.zh: 这是将平民——即使他们被怀疑是罪犯——视为战斗人员，并在没有任何正当程序的情况下杀害他们。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: So take me to the beginning of this story.
sentences.zh: 那么带我回到这个故事的开头。

sentences.en: Where does all this start?
sentences.zh: 这一切是从哪里开始的？

sentences.en: Well, for me and my colleagues like Colleen Cooper and Eric Schmidt, who cover the Pentagon, and Julian Barnes also covers intelligence.
sentences.zh: 嗯，对于我和我的同事们，比如报道五角大楼的科琳·库珀和埃里克·施密特，以及同样负责情报报道的朱利安·巴恩斯来说，

sentences.en: We've all been working on this a lot together.
sentences.zh: 我们一直在共同研究这个问题。

sentences.en: It starts in August when we picked up chatter and were able to confirm that Trump had secretly signed an order in late July directing the military to use military force,
sentences.zh: 这一切始于八月，当时我们收到了一些风声，并能够证实特朗普在七月下旬秘密签署了一项命令，指示军方使用武力，

sentences.en: that is to target with lethal force, suspected drug smugglers from groups that his administration had designated as terrorists.
sentences.zh: 也就是用致命武力针对他政府指定为恐怖分子的团体的疑似毒贩。

sentences.en: Normally, when Trump does something like that, he touts it, he puts it up on the internet, he signs it with a flourish in front of cameras.
sentences.zh: 通常情况下，当特朗普做这种事时，他会大肆宣传，发到网上，并在镜头前大张旗鼓地签署。

sentences.en: It was very unusual that this was happening without any publicity.
sentences.zh: 这次在没有任何公开报道的情况下发生，非常不寻常。

sentences.en: And so throughout August, we were watching as, number one, an enormous amount of naval firepower was moved into the South Caribbean Sea.
sentences.zh: 因此在整个八月，我们都在观察，首先，大量的海军火力被调往加勒比海南部。

sentences.en: And as the Trump administration ratcheted up its rhetorical attacks on Venezuela's government, its strongman president,
sentences.zh: 随着特朗普政府加剧对委内瑞拉政府及其强人总统的言辞攻击，

sentences.en: Nicolas Maduro, they kept calling him a cartel leader, illegitimate, etc., suggesting the focus was going to be Venezuelan.
sentences.zh: 尼古拉斯·马杜罗，他们一直称他为贩毒集团头目、非法总统等等，暗示重点将是委内瑞拉。

sentences.en: And indeed, on September 2nd,
sentences.zh: 事实上，在9月2日，

sentences.en: Trump is talking to some reporters in the Oval Office when he suddenly says, We just, over the last few minutes, literally shot out a boat, a drug-carrying boat,
sentences.zh: 特朗普在椭圆形办公室与一些记者交谈时突然说，我们刚刚，就在过去几分钟内，击沉了一艘船，一艘运毒船，

sentences.en: a lot of drugs in that boat.
sentences.zh: 那船上有大量的毒品。

sentences.en: That just that same day, the United States had conducted a military strike on a boat.
sentences.zh: 就在同一天，美国对一艘船只进行了军事打击。

sentences.en: Came out of Venezuela and coming out very heavily from Venezuela.
sentences.zh: 它来自委内瑞拉，而且是大量从委内瑞拉出来的。

sentences.en: A lot of things are coming out of Venezuela.
sentences.zh: 有很多东西正从委内瑞拉出来。

sentences.en: And that we would be hearing more about that.
sentences.zh: 我们很快会听到更多相关消息。

sentences.en: And soon after, on his social media platform, he posted a description of this strike.
sentences.zh: 不久之后，他在自己的社交媒体平台上发布了这次打击的描述。

sentences.en: He said he'd killed 11 people who were aboard the vessel, which he said was smuggling drugs on behalf of the Tren de Aragua Venezuelan gang, which he had designated as terrorists.
sentences.zh: 他说他杀死了船上的11人，并称该船正在为他指定为恐怖组织的委内瑞拉“阿拉瓜火车”帮派走私毒品。

sentences.en: And there was a video from different views of aerial surveillance showing a boat on water, not clear exactly who or what is on board.
sentences.zh: 还有一段来自不同视角的空中监视视频，显示水面上有一艘船，不清楚船上到底是谁或有什么东西。

sentences.en: And then it explodes.
sentences.zh: 然后它爆炸了。

sentences.en: And the scale of the death,
sentences.zh: 死亡规模，

sentences.en: 11 people, was also very striking because a boat that is smuggling cargo, one of these sort of go-fast boats, does not need a crew of 11.
sentences.zh: 11人，也非常引人注目，因为一艘走私货物的船，这种快艇，根本不需要11名船员。

sentences.en: That just takes up space.
sentences.zh: 那只会占用空间。

sentences.en: You could put more drugs on the boat if that's indeed what was happening.
sentences.zh: 如果那确实是正在发生的事情，你本可以在船上放更多的毒品。

sentences.en: And so it also immediately raised questions about who was actually on this boat, how good the intelligence was.
sentences.zh: 因此，这也立即引发了关于船上到底是谁、情报有多准确的质疑。

sentences.en: Was there some human trafficking going on too?
sentences.zh: 当时是否还有人口贩运活动？

sentences.en: Some migrants or something on the boat who had nothing to do with drugs and were also now killed.
sentences.zh: 船上是否有与毒品无关的移民或其他什么人，现在也被杀了。

sentences.en: But it was clear at that point that this secret order we had written about and this buildup of forces in the Caribbean Sea had now been used for the first time.
sentences.zh: 但当时很清楚，我们报道过的那个秘密命令以及在加勒比海的兵力集结，现在已经首次被使用了。

sentences.en: Charlie, it sounds like, one, this was a remarkable moment, and two, that you were actually skeptical that this was even a drug boat.
sentences.zh: 查理，听起来，第一，这是一个非同寻常的时刻，第二，你实际上怀疑这到底是不是一艘毒品船。

sentences.en: It wasn't clear based on the evidence.
sentences.zh: 根据证据来看并不清楚。

sentences.en: Well, there was no evidence.
sentences.zh: 嗯，根本没有证据。

sentences.en: There was just an assertion.
sentences.zh: 只有一种断言。

sentences.en: And then there was this oddity of why are there so many people on this boat.
sentences.zh: 而且还有一个奇怪的地方，为什么船上有那么多人。

sentences.en: And there was immediately a reaction among experts in the law of armed conflict,
sentences.zh: 武装冲突法领域的专家们立即做出了反应，

sentences.en: retired senior judge advocate general officers who used to be in charge of telling the military
sentences.zh: 那些曾经负责告诉军方界限在哪里、在武力使用方面什么是允许的退休高级军法官们，

sentences.en: where the limits lay and what was permissible in terms of using force.
sentences.zh: 界限在哪里以及在武力使用方面什么是允许的。

sentences.en: And a hallmark of the entire ethos is you do not deliberately target civilians, even criminal suspects, unless they are directly participating in hostilities.
sentences.zh: 整个精神的核心标志是，你不能蓄意针对平民，即使是刑事嫌疑人，除非他们直接参与了敌对行动。

sentences.en: And the Trump administration has not put out a detailed legal rationale for how this isn't just murder.
sentences.zh: 而特朗普政府并没有就这为何不仅仅是谋杀给出一个详细的法律依据。

sentences.en: They've gestured at the outlines of a rationale.
sentences.zh: 他们只是大致勾勒了一个理由。

sentences.en: What have they said exactly, Charlie, about the rationale behind this?
sentences.zh: 查理，他们到底是怎么说这次行动背后的理由的？

sentences.en: They have said that at a time in which 100,000 Americans a year die from drug overdoses,
sentences.zh: 他们说，在每年有10万美国人死于药物过量的时代，

sentences.en: Trump has the authority to lawfully decide that the criminal problem of drug smuggling and drug trafficking is essentially an armed attack on the United States,
sentences.zh: 特朗普有权合法地决定，毒品走私和贩运的犯罪问题本质上是对美国的武装攻击，

sentences.en: that the United States can use military force in self-defense against drug trafficking and that therefore he has constitutional authority to kill these people.
sentences.zh: 美国可以针对毒品贩运进行自卫性的军事打击，因此他拥有宪法赋予的权力来杀掉这些人。

sentences.en: The argument is that these drug trafficking groups are threatening Americans, are killing Americans with the drugs that they smuggle into the United States
sentences.zh: 论点是这些贩毒集团正在威胁美国人，正在用他们走私到美国的毒品杀害美国人，

sentences.en: and that that is enough to declare them terrorists.
sentences.zh: 而这足以宣布他们为恐怖分子。

sentences.en: At this point, all we have is, for the first attack especially, September 2nd, is President Trump's assertion that the intelligence was confident that this boat was carrying drugs
sentences.zh: 目前，我们所拥有的，特别是针对9月2日的第一次袭击，只是特朗普总统的断言，即情报部门确信这艘船载有毒品，

sentences.en: that would eventually be bound for the United States.
sentences.zh: 并且最终目的地是美国。

sentences.en: Further complicating that is just because if there are drugs on a boat just because they're leaving one country down there doesn't necessarily mean they're bound for here.
sentences.zh: 更复杂的是，仅仅因为船上有毒品，仅仅因为它们离开了一个国家，并不一定意味着它们的目的地是这里。

sentences.en: It looked like it was going to Trinidad and Tobago from Venezuela and that's often a transshipment point to Europe.
sentences.zh: 看起来它当时是从委内瑞拉前往特立尼达和多巴哥，而那通常是通往欧洲的转运点。

sentences.en: In any case, all we have is Trump saying we have recordings, we know it was on the boat.
sentences.zh: 无论如何，我们所拥有的只是特朗普说我们有录音，我们知道船上有什么。

sentences.en: Take our word for it, basically.
sentences.zh: 基本上就是让我们相信他的话。

sentences.en: Take our word for it.
sentences.zh: 相信他的话。

sentences.en: And then it turns out that the video he released, which shows a boat moving in the water and then blown apart, is not the whole story because it was edited
sentences.zh: 结果他发布的视频，显示一艘船在水面上移动然后被炸毁，并不是事情的全部，因为它是经过剪辑的，

sentences.en: and the people who have been briefed on the unedited video say that, number one, the boat had turned around before the United States military attacked it.
sentences.zh: 而看过未剪辑视频的人说，第一，在美国军方攻击之前，这艘船已经掉头了。

sentences.en: It had apparently seen an aircraft kind of stalking it and gotten freaked out, whoever was piloting the boat, and turned around and was pointed back towards Venezuela.
sentences.zh: 无论谁在驾驶这艘船，显然是看到了有飞机在跟踪它，感到惊慌，于是掉头指向委内瑞拉方向。

sentences.en: And two, that it didn't just take one strike to settle the matter.
sentences.zh: 第二，不仅仅是一次打击就解决了问题。

sentences.en: Even after the first strike disabled the boat, they struck it several more times to make it sink.
sentences.zh: 即使在第一次打击使船只瘫痪后，他们又进行了几次打击使其沉没。

sentences.en: And you're saying the boat was actually facing away from the United States when those strikes happened.
sentences.zh: 你是说当这些打击发生时，船实际上是背对着美国方向的。

sentences.en: That's apparently what the unedited surveillance video shows.
sentences.zh: 未剪辑的监视视频显然就是这样显示的。

sentences.en: And there was such controversy surrounding this thing the U.S.
sentences.zh: 而且围绕这件事的争议如此之大，以至于不清楚这是否是一次性的，还是他们会继续下去。

sentences.en: military had done that it wasn't clear whether this was going to be a one-off or they were going to keep going.
sentences.zh: 但就在上周，

sentences.en: But then last week,
sentences.zh: 特朗普宣布了对另外两艘船的第二次和第三次打击。

sentences.en: Trump announced a second and then a third strike on two more boats.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 在那些案例中，他每次都说他们杀死了每艘船上的三个人。

sentences.en: Each time, in those cases, he said they had killed three people aboard each of those vessels.
sentences.zh: 所以我们知道这不是一次性的。

sentences.en: So we know it's not a one-off.
sentences.zh: 这现在已经形成了一种模式。

sentences.en: It's now something of a pattern.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: That's right.
sentences.zh: 而且在某些方面，我们对后两次袭击了解得更少。

sentences.en: And we actually know less about them in some respects.
sentences.zh: 在第二次袭击中，

sentences.en: In the second attack,
sentences.zh: 特朗普说船上是委内瑞拉人，没有指明具体的组织。

sentences.en: Trump said that it was Venezuelans aboard, didn't identify a particular organization.
sentences.zh: 第三次袭击，他甚至没有给出船上人员的国籍，也没有指明他所说的幕后走私集团或帮派。

sentences.en: Third attack, he didn't even give a nationality for who was aboard or identify a particular cartel or gang he said was behind the smuggling.
sentences.zh: 我们确实知道他们说目前为止的每一次袭击都发生在国际水域。

sentences.en: We do know that they have said each of these attacks so far has taken place in international waters.
sentences.zh: 第三次袭击发生在多米尼加共和国海岸附近。

sentences.en: And the third attack took place off the coast of the Dominican Republic.
sentences.zh: 有趣的是，多米尼加共和国军队在周末前往袭击现场，并表示他们能够打捞起一些漂浮的包裹，看起来像是毒品，

sentences.en: And interestingly, the Dominican Republic forces went out to the site of the attack over the weekend and have said that they were able to recover some floating bales of what appear
sentences.zh: 他们还发布了一些照片。

sentences.en: to be drugs and they released some photographs of that.
sentences.zh: 这是我们拥有的第一个证据，证明其中至少一艘船上确实有毒品。

sentences.en: And that's the first evidence we have that there was, in fact, drugs on board apparently at least one of these vessels.
sentences.zh: 重点是，在每一个案例中，特朗普政府都没有提供足够的信息让我们独立评估到底发生了什么。

sentences.en: The point is, in each of these cases, the Trump administration is not giving us enough information to independently assess really what happened.
sentences.zh: 如果我们暂时相信他们的话，即这些是向美国走私大量毒品的毒贩，美国军方可以直接在水面上击沉这样的船只吗？

sentences.en: If we are to take them at their word for a moment that these were drug traffickers smuggling a bunch of drugs into the U.S., can the U.S.
sentences.zh: 这是允许的吗？

sentences.en: military just shoot boats like this out of the water?
